**eleQtron** 
 develops and operates full\-stack quantum computers based on trapped\-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic\-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high\-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC).
   

  

 A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault\-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high\-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics\-based modelling, hardware–software co\-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements.
   

  

 As part of our initiative towards fault\-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations \& Concepts team and are looking for a
 **Quantum Error Correction Scientist (f/m/d)** 
 to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company.
   

  

 Role Overview:
   

  

 As Quantum Error Correction Scientist (f/m/d), you will contribute to the development of QEC infrastructure, realistic circuit\-level noise modelling, decoder benchmarking, logical\-performance assessment, and hardware\-aware quantum error\-correction research.
   

  

 The role offers the opportunity to join at an early stage of eleQtron’s QEC effort, helping to establish the infrastructure that will be key for realistic QEC studies and first logical\-architecture demonstrations.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Build simulation and benchmarking infrastructure for realistic fault\-tolerance studies based on hardware\-derived noise models.
* Analyze logical performance, decoder strategies, resource requirements, and scaling behaviour of quantum error\-correction architectures.
* Collaborate with system operators, architects, and application scientists to connect hardware characterization with logical\-level performance assessments.
* Contribute to early logical\-computing demonstrations and the development of eleQtron’s future fault\-tolerance capabilities.


**Required Skills:**
* MSc with an outstanding MSc thesis or PhD in Physics, Quantum Information, Computer Science, or a closely related field.
* Solid background in quantum error correction and fault\-tolerant quantum computing (Experience with stabilizer formalisms, decoder frameworks, or realistic noise modelling)
* Excellent analytical skills in numerical simulations and performance modelling.
* Ability to work in an international and diverse team at the interface of theory, software, and hardware.
* Fluent communication in English


**What you can expect from eleQtron:**
* Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements.
* Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules.
* Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the game.
* Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members’ needs\-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development.
* Wellness Package: We offer health\-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well\-being.
* Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus.
* At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications.
* Modern workplace: We have a high\-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices, and meeting rooms.

**Office/Unit/Project Description**

The Human Development Report Office (HDRO) is a small multi\-disciplinary unit located in the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in New York. The mission of the HDRO is to advance human development through the expansion of opportunities, choice, and freedom. The Office works towards this goal by conducting original analysis and research, commissioning top quality background research, and advocating practical policy changes. It works with others to achieve change through writing and research, data analysis and presentation, support to national and regional analysis as well as outreach and advocacy work.


One of its best\-known outputs is the global Human Development Report (HDR), first launched in 1990\. These independent Reports are intended to challenge policies and approaches that constrain human development, promote innovative concepts and to advocate practical policy changes. In each Report, a different development theme is examined in\-depth using available data and new analyses relevant to the chosen topic resulting in both an assessment of current status as well as a series of policy recommendations for the future.


HDRO is expected to be a magnet for young, bright professionals who want to accelerate their careers, with an orientation towards research and analysis. HDRO expects a direct contribution to the content of the Report and other products, to the quality and relevance of the background research for the HDR, to maintaining good relationships with external research partners and other relevant stakeholders, and in capturing the diverse reflections of experts in consultations that inform research and report development.


**Scope of Work**

The Research Analyst will contribute to the HDRO’s strategic research, analysis, data management, and knowledge dissemination activities in support of the Human Development Reports (HDRs) and related human development initiatives.


**Conduct Human Development Research and Analysis and Support Development of Knowledge Products**

* Conduct research and analytical work on human development issues, trends, and emerging policy topics.
* Support the development of evidence\-based insights to inform HDRs and other HDRO Knowledge products.
* Contribute to literature reviews, quantitative and qualitative analysis, and synthesis of research findings.
* Contribute to the preparation and drafting of HDR content through research, data analysis, and written inputs.
* Review background research papers and supporting materials to ensure relevance, quality, and consistency with report objectives.
* Support quality assurance processes for HDRs, including factchecking, validation of data and reference, and verification of analytical findings.
* Contribute to the organization, maintenance, and accessibility of research materials, datasets, and supporting documentation.

**Contribute to the Human Development Data and Measurement**

* Contribute to the development, maintenance, and analysis of human development indicators and composite measures.
* Support the compilation, management, and interpretation of datasets related to human development outcomes and trends.
* Support the process of regional and thematic consultations, using them to validate research on human development and to incorporate feedback and diverse perspectives into analytical work.
* Contribute to joint research projects with partners, within and outside UNDP, on frontier analytical and policy issues related to human development.
* Support the translation of research findings into accessible and impactful communication products.
* Prepare inputs to briefing materials, presentations, and other knowledge products to support dissemination and stakeholder engagement activities.

**Collaborative and Organizational Support**

* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and collaborative activities within HDRO.
* Support the planning and implementation of research, publication, outreach, and dissemination activities.
* Perform other related analytical, research, and programmatic responsibilities as required to advance the objectives of the office.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.


**Institutional Arrangement**

Within the overall vision and the structure of HDRO, the Research Analyst, under the guidance of members from the Research Team and direct supervision of Research and Strategic Partnership Advisor, will provide analytical, substantive and research contributions to the work of HDRO. For more than 35 years, we have been developing cutting\-edge science and technology to empower biomedical research and personalized medicine. We combine excellence from more than 60 disciplines in natural sciences, engineering, and informatics to significantly contribute to biomedical sciences. We encourage a creative working environment driven by pioneering spirit – to seek new horizons – boldly envisioning the future and turning it into reality. Today, more than 4,900 experts from over 70 countries contribute to our sustainable success.

 **Job Description**  

Join us in driving the future of innovative cell\-based therapies at Miltenyi Biotec, where we develop groundbreaking treatments for cancer, autoimmune, and rare diseases. As an Analytical Project Leader in Quality Control, you will play a key role in turning cutting\-edge science into real\-world medical solutions.

**What You’ll Do**

* Within a matrix\-oriented project organization structure, you will serve as primary point of contact and analytical project lead for all international quality control activities related to cell therapy products. You will work closely together with the operative quality control teams, overseeing QC related project timelines for international roll\-out, deliverables, and risk management to ensure successful outcomes.
* You will take resonsibility for the international transfer and implementation of QC testing strategies for commercialized cell therapy products across Miltenyi sites and point\-of\-care centers, ensuring consistent quality standards worldwide.
* In collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders, you will author and review critical quality documentation, including validation protocols and reports, stability documents, specifications, and technology transfer packages. In addition, you will provide QC expertise and content for regulatory submissions, particularly for international markets beyond Europe and the United States.
* Together with QC and Quality Assurance colleagues, you will ensure the global comparability and equivalency of analytical testing for cell therapy products, maintaining alignment with approved filings and regulatory requirements across different regions.
* Partnering closely with the Project Management Office, you will coordinate QC\-related project activities across R\&D, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions. You will define project scope, monitor progress against key milestones, proactively address challenges, and ensure transparent communication to keep projects on track.
* Based on your level of expertise and growing professional development at Miltenyi, there is a pathway to take on a leadership role within the Quality Control team, where you can influence strategy, mentor colleagues, and drive key initiatives.

  

**Qualifications** **What We’re Looking For**

* You hold a Master's degree in Pharmacy, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related life sciences discipline. A PhD is considered an advantage.
* Several years of experience leading cross\-functional projects within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry have equipped you with a strong understanding of complex development and quality environments, ideally within GMP\-regulated Quality Control or analytical development.
* Through your excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, you build trusted relationships across functions, confidently navigate challenging situations, and drive alignment among diverse teams.
* A structured, analytical, and solution\-oriented mindset enables you to assess complex challenges, develop pragmatic solutions, and successfully move projects forward.
* Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken, allows you to clearly communicate scientific and technical topics to a wide range of stakeholders. Additional language skills are an asset.
* Willingness to travel internationally supports your collaboration with global teams and your involvement in technology transfer and implementation activities across Miltenyi sites and partner locations.

  

**Additional Information** **What we offer**

* Flexible and remote work: Enable time management on your terms
* Diversity: International teams and cross\-border intercultural communication
* Room for creativity: It’s the most clever solution that we always strive for
* Health \& Sport: We offer a wide range of corporate sports activities and health provision
* Miltenyi University: A clever mind never stops learning, take advantage of our inhouse Training Academy

**Diversity is the bedrock of our creativity.**


Our mission: To innovate treatments and technologies and tackle the world’s most serious health challenges. And that’s why we connect the dots –across various disciplines, linking different perspectives, skills, and abilities.


You and your talent are welcome here in our inclusive and collaborative environment. So come as you are. Regardless of gender, sexual identity, age, ethnicity, religion or disability.


Become part of our team and focus on pushing the borders of medicine.

**Contact us**


If you have the skills and qualifications for this position, please use the link to send us your details (application letter, curriculum vitae, references and certificates). Please give us some idea of when you can start and the kind of salary you are looking for, outlining the reasons you have made this application.

**Your role**
-------------


Reanalysis is central to ECMWF’s role as a global leader in Earth\-system prediction, climate monitoring and climate services. By combining observations with advanced data assimilation techniques, ECMWF provides comprehensive, high\-quality reanalyses of the atmosphere, land, ocean and wider climate system that are used worldwide for operational decision\-making, research, policy and commercial applications.


We are seeking a **Team Leader** for the **Climate Reanalysis (CRA) Team**, which develops, delivers and continually improves world\-leading global climate reanalysis datasets, including the ERA series (e.g. ERA5 and ERA6\) produced by ECMWF in the framework of EU’s Climate Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S).


The role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of climate reanalysis at ECMWF. You will guide scientific and technical developments in reanalysis production, quality assurance, uncertainty characterization and user\-oriented data provision, ensuring that ECMWF’s reanalysis activities continue to set international standards and respond to evolving scientific, policy and service needs.


As Team Leader, you will provide scientific and managerial leadership for a team of experienced scientists and technical specialists. Reporting to and supporting the Head of the Earth System Assimilation Section, you will help set priorities, plan and manage the team’s work, and foster effective collaboration across ECMWF, with Copernicus Climate Change Service partners, ECMWF Member and Co\-operating States, and the wider climate research and services community.

**About the Climate Reanalysis Team**
-------------------------------------


The Climate Reanalysis Team is part of ECMWF’s Earth System Assimilation Section in the Research Department and plays a central role in the scientific quality, evolution and production of ECMWF’s global reanalysis portfolio. Its work underpins global prediction and climate monitoring services, a wide range of international environmental research activities, and increasingly supports machine learning applications by providing training data.


The team develops and delivers global reanalyses: physically consistent reconstructions of the past state of the Earth system, produced by combining historical satellite and in\-situ observations with numerical models through the ECMWF data assimilation system. This includes maintaining the current ERA5 delivery, production of its successor ERA6, and leading research towards future next\-generation reanalysis products, by exploiting both four\-dimensional variational data assimilation (4D\-Var) and AI and machine learning technique.


The team works closely with colleagues across ECMWF in data assimilation, observations, atmospheric composition, land, ocean, sea ice, model development, production, evaluation and user services. It also engages with Member and Co\-operating States, Copernicus Climate Change Service partners and users to ensure that ECMWF’s reanalyses continue to meet the highest standards of scientific quality and operational reliability, while responding to evolving user and service needs.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


As Team Leader, you will:

* Lead and manage the Climate Reanalysis Team, setting objectives and priorities, supporting effective delivery, coaching and developing team members
* Work with the Head of Section and senior colleagues to shape ECMWF's scientific and technical strategy for the next generation of global analysis building on both 4D\-Var and IA techniques.
* Guide the design, production, evaluation and quality assurance of reanalysis datasets, ensuring scientific excellence, traceability, robustness and appropriate characterization of uncertainty
* Oversee the planning and timely execution of large\-scale reanalysis production activities, including the on\-going ERA6 production, ensuring that operational workflows, data delivery and issue resolution are well coordinated and effectively managed
* Foster collaboration across ECMWF and with Copernicus Climate Change Service partners, Member and Co\-operating States, research organizations and user communities, representing ECMWF where appropriate

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------


We are looking for someone who combines strong scientific expertise in climate reanalysis, Earth\-system data assimilation or closely related fields with practical, supportive leadership. You will be comfortable leading experienced scientists and technical specialists, setting clear priorities and maintaining a strong focus on scientific quality, operational delivery and user impact.


You will bring:

* An inclusive and decisive leadership style, empowering and developing team members
* Excellent scientific judgement and confidence to help shape priorities for climate reanalysis in a fast\-moving scientific, technical and service environment
* The ability to take an Earth\-system view of reanalysis, connecting observations, physics and AI\-based modelling, data assimilation, uncertainty estimation, production workflows and user requirements
* The ability to build trust and manage dependencies across scientific, technical, operational and user\-facing teams
* Strong listening and communication skills, including the ability to understand different user perspectives and to represent ECMWF effectively
* Strong organizational skills and the flexibility and resilience to lead a major multi\-year production and development programme, including adapting when priorities change or operational issues arise

**Your profile**
----------------

**Education**

* An advanced university degree or equivalent professional experience, in a relevant field

**Essential experience and knowledge**

* Track record in climate reanalysis, Earth\-system data assimilation, observational data usage or climate monitoring
* Experience contributing to the development, production, evaluation or application of large\-scale Earth\-system datasets, preferably in an operational or service\-oriented environment
* Demonstrated scientific and people leadership, including setting priorities and successfully leading cross\-cutting projects or teams

**Desirable experience and knowledge**

* Understanding of ECMWF reanalysis products and the scientific and technical challenges associated with their production
* Experience with reanalysis quality assurance, uncertainty estimation, observing\-system evaluation or climate data stewardship
* Experience engaging with climate services, operational or research users and international partners
* Awareness of emerging AI and machine\-learning approaches and their potential applications in climate reanalysis and Earth\-system prediction

**Languages**


Candidates must be able to work effectively in English and applications should be submitted in English. A good knowledge of one of the Centre’s other working languages (French or German) is an advantage.  

  

*If this role interests you and you meet several but not all of the criteria listed above, we still encourage you to apply.*

**About Copernicus**
--------------------

Copernicus is the flagship Earth observation component of the European Union (EU) space programme. Based on the exploitation of space\-based and Earth observations and scientific models, Copernicus provides validated information services for land, marine, atmosphere and climate monitoring, as well as emergency management and security. These services, and their free, open and quality\-assured data and tools, support a range of environmental and security applications across sectors and policy domains. ECMWF has been entrusted to operate two of these Services \- the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) and the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) \- on behalf of the European Commission, as well as being a contributor to the Copernicus Emergency Management Service.


The Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) service provides consistent and quality\-controlled information related to atmospheric composition, including air pollutants and greenhouse gases, solar energy, and climate forcing, everywhere in the world. For more information, see https://www.copernicus.eu/en/copernicus\-services/atmosphere


The Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) service provides authoritative information about the past, present and future climate, as well as tools to enable climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies by policy makers and businesses. For more information, see https://www.copernicus.eu/en/copernicus\-services/climate\-change


www.copernicus.eu


**About ECMWF**
---------------


The **European Centre for Medium\-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)** is a world leader in Numerical Weather Predictions providing high\-quality data for weather forecasts and environmental monitoring. As an intergovernmental organisation, we collaborate internationally to serve our members and the wider community with global weather predictions, data and training activities that are critical to contribute to safe and thriving societies.


The success of our activities depends on the funding and partnerships of the 35 Member and Co\-operating States who provide the support and direction of our work. Our talented staff together with the international scientific community, and our powerful supercomputing capabilities, are the core of a 24/7 research and operational centre with a focus on medium and long\-range predictions. We also hold one of the largest meteorological data archives in the world.


ECMWF has also developed a strong partnership with the European Union and has been entrusted with the implementation and operation of the **Destination Earth Initiative** and the Climate Change and Atmosphere Monitoring Services of the **Copernicus Programme** and the **Strengthening Early Warning in Africa (SEWA) Programme**. Other areas of work include High Performance Computing and the development of digital tools that enable ECMWF to extend provision of data and products covering weather, climate, air quality, fire and flood prediction and monitoring.


Our vision: The strength of a common goal  

Our mission: Deliver global numerical weather predictions focusing on the medium\-range and monitoring of the Earth system to and with our Member States


ECMWF is a multi\-site organisation, with its headquarters in Reading, UK, a data centre in Bologna, Italy, and a large presence in Bonn, Germany, as a central location for our EU\-related activities. ECMWF is internationally recognised as the voice of expertise in numerical weather predictions for forecasts and climate science.


www.ecmwf.int

**Other information**
---------------------

**Grade remuneration:** The successful candidates will be recruited according to the scales of the Co\-ordinated Organisations. In addition to basic salary, ECMWF also offers an attractive benefits package. Information about working with us and full details of salary scales and allowances are available on the ECMWF website at:


www.ecmwf.int/en/about/jobs/working\-ecmwf.

**Starting date:** 01 January 2027

**Location:** Reading, UK or Bonn, Germany (Candidates are expected to relocate to the duty station)

**Remote work:** As a multi\-site organisation, ECMWF has adopted a hybrid organisation model which allows flexibility to staff to mix office working and teleworking. We allow for remote work 10 days/month away from the office, including up to 80 days/year away from the duty station country (within the area of our member states and co\-operating states).


Interviews by videoconference (MS Teams) will be conducted in English and are expected to take place approximately a month after the closing date.


Successful applicants and members of their family forming part of their households will be exempt from immigration restrictions.


If you require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment process, please let us know. To contact the ECMWF Recruitment Team, please email jobs@ecmwf.int.

**Who can apply**
-----------------

Applicants are invited to complete the online application form by clicking on the**apply**button below.


At ECMWF, we consider an inclusive environment as key for our success. We are dedicated to ensuring a workplace that embraces diversity and provides equal opportunities for all, without distinction as to race, gender, age, marital status, social status, disability, sexual orientation, religion, personality, ethnicity and culture. We value the benefits derived from a diverse workforce and are committed to having staff that reflect the diversity of the countries that are part of our community, in an environment that nurtures equality and inclusion.


Applications are invited from nationals from ECMWF Member States and Co\-operating States.


ECMWF Member and Co\-operating States are: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Montenegro, Morocco, the Netherlands, Norway, North Macedonia, Portugal, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Türkiye and the United Kingdom.

**In these exceptional times, we also welcome applications from Ukrainian nationals for this vacancy (note: ECMWF will not be able to assist with leaving the country).** Applications from nationals from other countries may be considered in exceptional cases.

This position is located in the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) Regional Office for the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) in Nassau, the Bahamas. and acts as Regional Representative of the Regional Office. The incumbent represents the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights and reports to the Director of the Americas Region, Global Operations Division in coordination with the Chief of the Regional Liaison Team for the Americas.
  
Responsibilities
  
Within delegated authority, the Senior Human Rights Officer will be responsible for the following duties: • Leads and coordinates the work of the CARICOM Regional Office following its mandate of monitoring, advisory services, technical cooperation, protection and promotion of human rights. • Formulates human rights strategies, including from a gender equality perspective; develops a vision or direction for the work of the CARICOM Regional Office and creates the conditions for implementing that vision or direction. • Advises the Governments on human rights matters. • Advises UN Resident Coordinators and the UN Country Teams on strategies to build and strengthen national capacities and institutions for the promotion and protection of human rights. • Exercises daily management of the office, including oversight of all logistic, financial and human resources aspects in accordance with relevant UN Rules and Procedures. • Represents the High Commissioner on matters of human rights in the region. • Builds and maintains relationships with the Caribbean countries authorities, Ambassadors, Heads of UN Agencies and other intergovernmental organizations and non\-governmental organizations on human rights issues and implementation of programmes. • Proposes policy directives and plan of action to appropriate United Nations bodies for immediate and long\- range solutions to human rights problems in general and specific geographical areas. • Designs, develops and implements significant policy and program changes to address regional or global human rights issues, including their gender dimensions. • Formulates the programme of work, budget and medium\-term plan of the regional office and participates in the overall formulation and approval of the programme of work, and administrative matters. • Effectively promotes fund\-raising strategies at local level to ensure financial sustainability of the regional field presence and the strengthening of human and financial resources. • Prepares human rights reports on key sectors or key regional developments. • Develops and maintains relations with officials at the highest levels of governments and advises them on human rights issues and policies. • Coordinates and oversees human rights research initiatives. • Manages OHCHR CARICOM Regional Office including supervision, management, guidance, development and coaching of international and national staff • Performs other related duties as required.
  
Competencies
  
* PROFESSIONALISM: Knowledge of and exposure to a range of human rights issues including approaches and techniques to address and advise on highly sensitive and complex problems in their political, ethnic, racial, gender and socio\-economic dimensions. Knowledge of institutional mandates of human rights organizations, prevailing policies and procedures. Ability to evaluate and integrate information from a variety of sources and assess impact on the human rights situation in the region or country of assignment, including the political environment and legal statutes as they pertain to human rights. Ability to complete in\-depth studies and reach conclusions on possible causes and solutions to human rights problems in specific societies and systems. Ability to relate and advise on human rights issues and perspectives, including their gender equality dimensions, to political, social, economic and humanitarian programmes in affected countries and areas. Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. • COMMUNICATION: Speaks and writes clearly and effectively; listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately; asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two\-way communication; tailors language, tone, style and format to match audience; demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed. • TEAMWORK: Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise; is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda; supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position; shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings. • LEADERSHIP: Serves as a role model that other people want to follow: empowers others to translate vision into results; is proactive in developing strategies to accomplish objectives; establishes and maintains relationships with a broad range of people to understand needs and gain support; anticipates and resolves conflicts by pursuing mutually agreeable solutions; drives for change and improvements; does not accept the status quo; shows the courage to take unpopular stands. Provides leadership and takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work; demonstrates knowledge of strategies and commitment to the goal of gender balance in staffing. • JUDGEMENT/DECISION\-MAKING: Identifies the key issues in a complex situation, and comes to the heart of the problem quickly; gathers relevant information before making a decision; considers positive and negative impacts of decisions prior to making them; takes decisions with an eye to the impact on others and on the Organization; proposes a course of action or makes a recommendation based on all available information; checks assumptions against facts; determines the actions proposed will satisfy the expressed and underlying needs for the decision; makes tough decisions when necessary.

Job \- Specific Qualification

Work Experience
  
A minimum of ten years of progressively responsible experience in human rights, political affairs, international relations, law or related area is required. Experience in designing and delivering capacity\-building initiatives on international and regional human rights mechanisms is required. Experience in high\-level policy and advocacy engagement with senior government officials and high\-level decision\-makers on human rights, governance, and institutional reform processes is required. Experience supporting the integration of human rights into strategic planning and programming processes at the national or country level, including through inter\-agency or multi\-stakeholder coordination mechanisms, is required. Experience in integrating human rights into humanitarian response to natural disasters and recovery efforts is required. At least two years of experience managing a large team is desirable. Experience providing advisory services and technical cooperation in field settings is desirable.

Masters of Digital GmbH
   

  

 Masters of Digital (MOD Education) ist ein AZAV\-zertifizierter Bildungsträger mit Schwerpunkt auf digitalen Weiterbildungen. Unsere Kurse richten sich an Menschen, die aktuell arbeitssuchend sind und ihre Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt nachhaltig verbessern möchten. Über einen Bildungsgutschein der Bundesagentur für Arbeit oder des Jobcenters können Teilnehmende \- bei Vorliegen der individuellen Voraussetzungen \-
 **kostenfrei**

 In unseren praxisnahen Programmen vermitteln erfahrene Dozent:innen aktuelles Wissen aus den Bereichen digitales Marketing, HR und weiteren Zukunftsfeldern. Ziel ist, die Teilnehmenden gezielt auf ihren beruflichen Neustart im digitalen Umfeld vorzubereiten \- mit echten Tools, realitätsnahen Aufgaben und individueller Betreuung.
   

  

 Wir glauben an lebenslanges Lernen und daran, dass jede Person eine faire berufliche Perspektive verdient. Deshalb unterstützen wir unsere Teilnehmenden nicht nur während der Weiterbildung, sondern stärken auch Selbstvertrauen, digitale Kompetenzen und Jobsicherheit für die Zukunft.
   

  

 Das erwartet Dich
   

  

 Diese Weiterbildung hat das Ziel, dich praxisnah auf eine konkrete berufliche Rolle im Digitalbereich vorzubereiten und dir aktuelles Fachwissen sowie direkt anwendbare Skills zu vermitteln. Nach Abschluss bist du bestmöglich darauf vorbereitet, in diesem Berufsfeld durchzustarten und deine Karriere weiterzuentwickeln.
   

  

**Weiterbildungsschwerpunkte**
* Du lernst die strategischen Grundlagen kennen – Marktverständnis, Wettbewerbsanalyse, Zieldefinition sowie Personas und Customer Journeys.
* Du entwickelst Contentstrategien mit Markenpositionierung, Storytelling und psychologischen Wirkmechanismen und nutzt KI für Ideenentwicklung und Produktion.
* Du verstehst die Plattformlogiken und Algorithmen von Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest und YouTube und baust organische Reichweite nachhaltig auf.
* Du setzt Paid\-Social\-Kampagnen mit Targeting, Creatives und Influencer Marketing um und optimierst sie systematisch anhand von KPI\-Systemen und Reportings.


 Unsere MOD Academy bietet dir eine innovative, didaktisch fundierte Lernumgebung mit Live\-Sessions, interaktiven Übungen und praxisnahen Projekten. Du lernst online und ortsunabhängig \- begleitet von erfahrenen Dozierenden aus der Praxis, die dich während der gesamten Weiterbildung unterstützen. So kannst du dich Schritt für Schritt fachlich weiterentwickeln und dich optimal auf deinen nächsten Karriereschritt vorbereiten.
   

  

 Dein Profil
   

  

 Du bist arbeitslos gemeldet, verfügst über ein gutes Sprachgefühl und möchtest dich weiterbilden? Dieser Kurs bietet dir die perfekte Basis dafür!
   

  

**Persönliche Voraussetzungen**

* Lernbereitschaft, analytisches Denken und Textsicherheit
* Arbeitslos gemeldet für die Förderung durch den Bildungsgutschein


**Technische Voraussetzungen**
* Grundlegende PC\- oder Tablet\-Kenntnisse
* Einen eigenen Laptop, PC oder ein Tablet/iPad
* Stabiles Internet
* Eine ruhige und geeignete Homeoffice\-Umgebung


 Deine Vorteile
   

  

* 100% Förderung: Dein Kurs wird vollständig über den Bildungsgutschein finanziert

Wo bewirbst du dich?
   

  

 Wir sind die ZUFALL logistics group – ein Team von über 2\.000 Mitarbeitenden an 11 Standorten, das gemeinsam mit Herz und Hand zukunftsfähige Logistiklösungen schafft.
   

  

**Mit Herz** 
 … weil wir auf echtes Miteinander setzen, bei dem man ehrlich und direkt miteinander umgeht:
   

  

 Hier bist du nicht irgendwer, \#HierBistDuWer.
   

  

**Mit Hand** 
 … weil Logistik ein harter Job ist. Aber auch einer, der richtig spannend ist. Herausforderung pur.
   

  

 \#WirBeiZUFALL wollen für unsere Kund:innen täglich das Beste erreichen. Und das seit 1928\.
   

  

 Unsere Dienstleistungen sollen der Gesellschaft nutzen, die Welt für nachfolgende Generationen erhalten und ein guter Arbeitsplatz sein für alle, die hier arbeiten. Denn nur so funktioniert Logistik bei \#WirBeiZUFALL.
   

  

**Klingt nach einem Umfeld, in dem Du arbeiten willst? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!**
 Wozu brauchen wir diese Stelle?
   

  

 Wir sind stolz darauf, dass wir schon fast 100 Jahre erfolgreich im Bereich Transport sind und wollen uns weiterentwickeln. Dazu brauchen wir dich \- auf dem Weg in eine nachhaltige Logistikwelt.

 werden Ideen in die Niederlassung gebracht und neue Wege bestritten. Hierzu gilt es die Zukunft aktiv mit all
   

  

 ihren Herausforderungen zu gestalten. Dabei versuchen wir nicht nur den aktuellen Entwicklungen gerecht zu
   

  

 werden, vielmehr gilt es Trends in der Spedition\- und Logistikbranche zu erkennen und sie umzusetzen.
   

  

 Mit unseren sehr ambitionierten Zielen für die kommenden Jahre gilt es wichtige Weichen zu stellen, Meilensteine zu definieren und den Erfolg gemeinsam zu gestalten.
   

  

 Was kannst du dazu beitragen, dass wir die Herausforderungen gut bewältigen?

* Du unterstützt die Führungskräfte der Niederlassung bei der Durchführung von Aktionen, Projekten, Workshops sowie Maßnahmen bei anstehenden Veränderungsprozessen

* Ausgezeichnete organisatorische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten
* Du weißt, was es braucht um ein Team zusammenzuhalten und gemeinsam voranzukommen
* Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift,
* Kundenorientiertes Denken und Handeln

Für das CWS Hygiene Team suchen wir eine/\-n
   

  

**Vertriebler im Außendienst B2B\-Neukunden (w/m/d)**
**Auf einen Blick**
* Außendienst, 100 % beim Kunden \+ Admin\-Zeit im Homeoffice \- kein Büro\-Pflichttag
* Vollzeit, Mo\-Fr (37 Stunden/ Woche), Vertrauensarbeitszeit, freie Zeiteinteilung
* 12 Monate zusätzliche finanzielle Absicherung für das 1\. Jahr \- geteiltes Risiko
* Dienstwagen zur Wahl (Skoda bis Mercedes, Zuzahlungsmodell), auch privat


**Du gewinnst Kunden nicht einmal, sondern Tag für Tag**
 Wir sind im Mietgeschäft zuhause \- kein klassischer Produktverkauf. Das heißt: deine Kunden bleiben dir erhalten, wenn dein Produkt jeden Tag bei ihnen sauber arbeitet. Wenn du gerne Menschen zuhörst, Probleme löst und dir deinen Erfolg selbst baust, bist du hier goldrichtig.
   

  

 Kein Powerpoint\-Onboarding. Sondern 7 Monate, die dich wirklich vorbereiten!
   

  

 Die meisten Unternehmen sagen: 'Wir begleiten dich am Anfang.' Was das in der Praxis bedeutet, ist oft ein Aktenordner und ein Kollege, der keine Zeit hat. Bei uns ist das anders \- und das ist kein Marketing\-Versprechen, sondern ein strukturiertes Programm mit eigenem Trainerteam, festen Touchpoints und einem echten Abschluss.
   

  

 So startest du \- Sales Navigator, unser 7\-Monats\-Programm
   

  

  

* Welcome Day: Einstieg in Unternehmen, Produktwelt, Kundenstruktur, Bereichsrallye
* Sales Basecamp Grundlagen (3 Wochen Präsenz): Produkte, Kalkulationen, Verträge, PONSOF\-Vertriebstraining (4T), Omnichannel von A bis Z (4T)
* Fundament in der Praxis (10 Wochen): Mitfahrten mit Service, Monteure vom technischen Dienst und erfahrenen Vertrieblern, plus wöchentliche Sales Power\-Up\-Sessions und Omni TouchPoints
* Train.Repeat.Perform (2 Präsenz\-Tage): Wissenscheck und Aufbautraining
* Kompetenz\-Ausbau (12 Wochen): eigenständiges Arbeiten in deiner Region, Vertriebsleiter eng dran
* Final Check (Monat 7\): Kompetenztag mit Kundengespräch und Omni\-Check, Gap\-Analysis\-Gespräch mit Sales Director, Vertriebsleiter und Trainer
* Newbie Sprechstunde


**Dein Team**
 Du wirst Teil eines 10\-köpfigen Regionalteams: 6 Account Manager, 2 Hunter, 1 Großkundenbetreuer, 1 Vertriebssupport und eure Vertriebsleitung. Wir haben die Teams bewusst klein gehalten, damit Führung nahbar bleibt und du nie 'eine oder einer von hundert' bist.
   

  

 Geführt wird über Zahlen \- wir sind ein zahlengetriebenes Haus und stehen dazu. Aber Zahlen sind kein Selbstzweck: Wir schauen gemeinsam auf den Forecast, besprechen wo es hakt, und welche Maßnahmen helfen. Live\-Mitfahrten mit unseren Trainerinnen und Trainern sind fester Bestandteil \- unabhängig von deiner Vertriebsleitung, als neutraler Sparring\-Kanal.
   

  

**Deine Aufgaben**
* Eigenverantwortliche Neukundenakquise (Kaltakquise) in deinem exklusiven Vertriebsgebiet \- Branche frei wählbar, kein festes Kundenprofil.
* Wochenplanung und Terminierung in Eigenregie \- Richtwert: 8 Kundentermine pro Tag, davon ca. 4 Angebote.
* Angebotserstellung, Nachfassen, Vertragsabschluss inklusive Preisgespräch \- teils direkt vor Ort digital unterschrieben.
* Alle Kundentermine und Angebote in Salesforce pflegen.
* Die digitale Waschraumlösung (App auf dem iPad) als Überraschungs\- und Verkaufsargument einsetzen \- echter Differenzierungswert gegenüber dem Wettbewerb.


 Was NICHT zu deiner Rolle gehört: Kündigungen von Bestandskunden, Montagen, Service\- und Rechnungsthemen. Das übernehmen Support, Innendienst und der Technische Dienst \- bewusste Entlastung, damit du dich auf Neukundengewinnung konzentrieren kannst.
   

  

 Perspektive: Langfristige Entwicklung Richtung Vertriebsleitung, Wechsel ins Bestandskundenmanagement oder in die Großkundenbetreuung \- oder Mentor\-Rolle für neue Hunter. Diese Entwicklungsrolle wird bei uns in den nächsten Jahren noch wichtiger.
   

  

**Was du mitbringst**
* Verbindung aufzubauen \- und bringst das Gespräch auch zum Abschluss.
* Resilienz gegenüber Absagen: Im Vertrieb hat niemand eine 90%\-Abschlussquote \- Neins gehören zum Weg zum Erfolg dazu. Genau diese Widerstandskraft macht dich im Neukundengeschäft stark.
* Hohe Reise\- und Flexibilitätsbereitschaft: Im Schnitt bist du 80% deiner Arbeitszeit unterwegs, mit effizient geplanten Touren in deinem Gebiet \- dafür möglichst wenig Zeit am Steuer. Gelegentlich, aber nicht standardmäßig, kann daraus auch mal ein späterer Termin am Abend werden.
* Hohe Selbstorganisation: eigenverantwortliche Tourenplanung, eigenständige Branchen\- und Kundenwahl, kaum feste Vorgaben. Wer viel Struktur von außen braucht, tut sich hier schwer.
* IT\-Grundaffinität: Salesforce, digitale Vertragsunterschrift und die App auf dem iPad nutzt du täglich.
* Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau \- Kundengespräche laufen vollständig auf Deutsch.


**Was dich erwartet**
* Dein eigenes, exklusives Postleitzahlengebiet \- niemand sonst wildert dort
* Freie Branchenwahl \- kein festgelegtes Kundenprofil, du wählst selbst, wo dein Potenzial am größten ist
* Sales Navigator: 7 Monate strukturierte Einarbeitung mit eigenem Trainerteam und Final Check in Monat 7 \- deutlich über Markt\-Standard
* Ungedeckelte Provision plus Fixgehalt, Urlaubs\- und Weihnachtsgeld \- eine Kombination, die du im Vertrieb selten findest
* Dienstwagen nach Wahl (Skoda bis Mercedes), auch privat nutzbar, inkl. Tankkarte
* Digitale Waschraumlösung als echter Wow\-Effekt im Kundengespräch \- Innovationsvorsprung gegenüber dem Wettbewerb
* Offene, sehr erfahrene Teamkultur mit echtem Wissensaustausch statt Konkurrenzdenken
* 27 Urlaubstage im ersten Jahr, ab dem zweiten Jahr 30 Tage
* Strategisch zentrale Rolle: Neukundengeschäft ist aktuell das Fundament unserer Wachstumsstrategie


**Wer wir sind**
 CWS steht seit über 70 Jahren für Dienstleistungen und hochwertige Produkte rund um Hygiene, Waschraum und Arbeitsschutz \- im Mietmodell, bundesweit, mit Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir sind Marktführer in unserem Segment und gleichzeitig in Bewegung: neue Teamstrukturen, KI\-gestützte Vertriebsprozesse, erweitertes Trainerteam. Stabilität und Veränderung schließen sich bei uns nicht aus.
   

  

 Lust auf ein Gespräch?
   

  

 Dann melde dich \- ein Lebenslauf reicht uns (ein Anschreiben, Arbeitszeugnisse und Foto brauchen wir nicht). Wir schauen uns deinen CV an und melden uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.
   

  

 Ansprechperson: Sarah Engels, HR
   

  

 E\-Mail: Zukunft@cws.com
   

  

 Vielfalt bei CWS.
   

  

 Bei uns zählt, was du leistest \- nicht woher du kommst. Chancengleichheit ist selbstverständlich, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, körperlichen Einschränkungen oder sexueller Identität. Bewerbende mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

 erforderlich ist.

* Eigensteuerung: Bei uns bist Du angestellt, aber wir schätzen Teams, die unternehmerisch denken. Es fällt Dir leicht, Dich selbst zu managen und Du hast stets ein Auge für mögliche Entwicklungspotenziale.


**Tätigkeiten**
* Support zum Start: Die ersten Wochen unterstützen wir Dich mit einem gezielten Online\-Ausbildungsprogramm in unserer hauseigenen Academy.

* Dein Netzwerk: Du erhältst zum Start ein umfassendes Partnernetzwerk aus namhaften Bank\-, Finanzdienstleistungs\- und Versicherungsinstituten, das Dich kontinuierlich mit ausreichend Leads versorgt.

 Ein motiviertes Vertriebsteam mit starkem Zusammenhalt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, Erfolge partnerschaftlich zu erreichen – nach dem Motto: gemeinsam voran.
   

  

**Über das Unternehmen**
 Inmitten der lebendigen Immobilienbranche nimmt die PlanetHome Group eine herausragende Stellung ein:
   

  

 Unser Fokus liegt klar auf der Vermittlung und Finanzierung von Wohnimmobilien in Deutschland und Österreich. Als Dachgesellschaft vereint die PlanetHome Group verschiedene Unternehmen, darunter PlanetHome Immobilien, PlanetHome Finanzierung und PlanetHome Immobilien Austria. Diese Vielfalt schafft nicht nur ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, sondern ermöglicht es uns auch, umfassende Lösungen anzubieten.
   

  

 Was die PlanetHome Group einzigartig macht, sind unsere starken Partnerschaften mit renommierten Institutionen wie der HypoVereinsbank, Commerzbank, apoBank, Sparda\-Bank, Comdirect, Deutsche Vermögensberatung, BBBank und Allianz. Gemeinsam gestalten wir nicht nur erfolgreiche Geschäftsbeziehungen, sondern auch nachhaltige Erfolgsgeschichten.
   

  

 Qualität und Auszeichnungen sind für uns Leitprinzipien. Als Träger des Qualitätssiegels "Top Service Deutschland" und als erster bundesweit tätiger Immobiliendienstleister, der nach DIN EN 15733 zertifiziert wurde, setzen wir Maßstäbe in Bezug auf Qualität und Vertrauen.
   

  

 Unsere Erfolge sprechen für sich – mit einem Objektverkaufsvolumen von 1,5 Mrd. Euro im Jahr 2023, dem Verkauf von 4500 Einheiten pro Jahr, einem Finanzierungsvolumen von 550 Mio. Euro und 6000 erfolgreichen Finanzierungsabschlüssen. Diese Erfolge sind nicht nur Meilensteine, sondern auch eine Bestätigung unseres kontinuierlichen Wachstumskurses.
   

  

 In unserer Welt, in der Karrieren geformt und Zukunft gestaltet wird, laden wir Dich ein, Teil unserer Reise zu sein. Entdecke die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten eines etablierten Unternehmens, das nicht nur berufliche Perspektiven, sondern auch inspirierende Zukunftsaussichten bietet.
   

  

 Willkommen bei der PlanetHome Group – wo Erfahrungen gemacht und Zukunft geschaffen wird.
   

  

 Klicke auf "Bewerben" für Details zu den Benefits, dem Team und dem Bewerbungsprozess.

 Wenn du Lust auf ein motiviertes Team, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit Perspektive hast, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
 



  

  




**Filialleitung (m/w/d) \- INTERSPORT Begro Herborn**

**Du führst gerne Teams, behältst Kennzahlen im Blick und möchtest Verantwortung für eine gesamte Filiale übernehmen?
   

 Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, triffst Entscheidungen und verstehst es, Mitarbeiter und Verkauf gleichermaßen weiterzuentwickeln?
   

 Dann könnte diese Position gut zu dir passen.** 




 INTERSPORT Begro steht seit über 25 Jahren für Kompetenz im Sportfachhandel, persönliche Beratung und starke Marken. Für unsere Filiale in Herborn suchen wir eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt und gemeinsam mit ihrem Team den Erfolg der Filiale aktiv gestaltet.
   

  




**Deine Aufgaben**
* Du übernimmst die operative Leitung der Filiale und trägst die Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg
* Du führst, motivierst und entwickelst dein Team
* Du sorgst für eine optimale Warenpräsentation und ein ansprechendes Storebild
* Du steuerst Warenbestände, Kennzahlen und Abläufe
* Du stellst eine kompetente und serviceorientierte Beratung sicher
* Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein


**Das erwartet dich bei uns**
* Viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum
* Direkter Einfluss auf Team, Verkauf und Filialentwicklung
* Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven
* Mitarbeiterrabatte auf starke Sportmarken
* Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld im Sportfachhandel
* Kurze Entscheidungswege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung
* Ein motiviertes Team mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
* Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten Unternehmen
* Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt an der Filiale


**Das Wichtigste zum Schluss**

 Die Position passt gut zu dir, wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, gerne Entscheidungen triffst und dein Team aktiv auf der Fläche führst.
 



 Wir suchen keine reine Verwaltungsrolle, sondern eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die Verkauf, Organisation und Team gleichermaßen im Blick behält.
 



**Wenn du wirtschaftlich denkst, strukturiert arbeitest und gemeinsam mit deinem Team etwas bewegen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.**

* Erfahrung im Einzelhandel, idealerweise mit Führungsverantwortung
